[[File:ArtusPrimeIon.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Ion cannon/Legends|Ion cannons]] protecting the mining facility on [[Artus Prime]].]]
The '''Artus Prime Mining Facility''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] complex where [[Artusian crystal]]s were extracted. 

The colony administrator gave weekly reports with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The last one was about a discovery of a large deposit of Artusian crystals.<ref name="NRIR">{{LucasArts|url=products/outcast/html/spin.html|text=N.R.I. Reports|int=N.R.I. Reports}}</ref> Soon after the [[Empire Reborn]] forces, under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Galak Fyyar]], captured the facility in order to obtain the Artusian crystals which were crucial to his [[Shadowtrooper|project]] to infuse [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] into [[Human/Legends|Human]] subjects. After Imperials took control of the facility most of the miners, who worked in the colony, were [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] while others were transported to [[Kejim Outpost|Kejim research labs]] where they were used as test subjects.

The Empire Reborn had a relatively large [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] at the facility, numbering around 300 personnel, with at least eight [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]] and a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] supporting them.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref> The facility was also protected by two [[Ion cannon/Legends|Ion cannons]].

In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the facility was infiltrated by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] [[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Jan Ors]]. This resulted in the [[Battle of Artus Prime]] after which the mining operations were shut down and the Imperial Remnant presence was eliminated.
